description: This file provides type declarations for the 'semver' library, defining the SemVer class and its methods for type checking and autocompletion purposes.

classes.name: SemVer
classes.description: Type declaration for the SemVer class representing semantic versioning with methods for comparison and version manipulation.

methods.name: constructor(version: string | SemVer, optionsOrLoose?: boolean | semver.RangeOptions); constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new SemVer instance with a version string or another SemVer object, with optional options for loose parsing.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the version string in the canonical format.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Returns a string suitable for debugging.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares this version to another, excluding build identifiers.

methods.name: compareMain
methods.description: Compares the main release portion of this version to another.

methods.name: comparePre
methods.description: Compares the prerelease portions of this version.

methods.name: compareBuild
methods.description: Compares the build identifiers of this version.

methods.name: inc
methods.description: Increments the version based on the release type and optional identifier.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the version as a string.
